name: print-social-holi-festival-stories-coral-cream-colour-powder-pots
title: 'Holi, The Festival of Color' story set in coral and cream with illustrated powder pots and mandala patterns
whatItIs: Ten vertical story cards in coral and cream, each with a flat illustration of stacked colourful powder pots (gulal), faint mandala flower patterns, small colour-swatch squares, and headlines ('Holi Fest', 'Happy Holi', 'Enjoy the Holi Fest') with event details.
whatItMeans: Vibrant and cultural; illustrated powder pots and mandala patterns capture Holi's colour and joy without needing photography.
techniques: Illustrate the festival's signature object (powder pots) as the hero motif.
Use faint mandala patterns as a culturally resonant background texture.
Show small colour swatches as a literal palette preview.

vocabulary.definition: The coloured powder traditionally used during Holi.
A concentric, symmetrical geometric pattern of spiritual origin.
